  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIFTH SEMESTER B.TECH. EXAMINATIONS - JANUARY 2024  
  SUBJECT: HUM 3052/HUM-3052-ESSENTIALS OF MANAGEMENT  
  ESSENTIALS OF MANAGEMENT [HUM 3052]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1A)          List the steps involved in the process of delegation.  
  (2)  
  
  1B)          How do Japanese management practices differ from American management practices?  
  (3)  
  
  1C)          John runs a law firm in Hyderabad. His firm offers valuable financial and legal  
  consultancy services to the clients. The firm has identified 6 vacancies recently and  
  decided to fill all six vacancies by experienced people with a job title 'Finance and Legal  
  Experts'.  
  (5)  
  Question to be answered:  
  List the possible methods of recruitment theoretically and mention the preferred method  
  for this case. Also, develop the job description and job specification for this post.  
  
  2A)          Sketch and mention the four strategies resulting from a portfolio matrix.  
  (2)  
  
  2B)          Using a clear diagram, describe the Systems Approach to Staffing and explain its  
  significance in the recruitment/selection process.                                             (3)  
  
  2C)          "Managing by objectives is nothing new here", said commissioner Chidambaram of the  
  metropolis Police Department. "We have always had important objectives toward which  
  everyone in my department strives.Our job is to maintain law and order, firmly but  
  fairly; to protect human lives and property; and to be the conscience and spirit of the  
  general welfare of the millions of people who call our city home. Everyone in this  
  department knows these objectives. Every man and woman knows that he or she must  
  work toward them and that, if they do not, they will be replaced. I recognise that in a  
  manufacturing concern you can measure objectives by profits, sales costs, and product  
  output. We can't, of course, do that, for we are a service operation. But this does not (5)  
  mean that we are not managing by objectives. Ask anyone in my department!  
  
  Questions to be answered:  
  i) Is Commissioner Chidambaram engaging in managing by objectives? What, if  
  anything, is missing? Explain with the help of MBO flow chart.  
  ii) Develop the quantitative objectives in any three key result areas by referring to Peter  
  F Drucker's philosophy on "Management By Objectives" in relation to the above case.

  3A)   List ANY FOUR principles of organizing as suggested by Lyndall Urwick. Explain two  
  principles briefly.                                                                (2)  
  
  3B)   Radhika opens a jewellery showroom in Jaipur after completing a course in jewellery  
  designing. She has employed 11 persons in her showroom. For greater productivity, she  
  divides the work into small tasks, and each employee is trained to perform his/her  
  specialized job. The sales persons are allowed to close a deal with a buyer by giving a  
  maximum of 10% discount, whereas the decision to give any further discount rests with  
  Radhika as the final authority. In the earlier days of starting the business, five of her  
  employees were asked to put in extra hours of work. In return, she had promised to give  
  them a special incentive within a year. Therefore, after six months when the business  
  was doing well, she awarded a cash bonus to each of these employees to honour her         (4)  
  commitment. However, when it comes to settling the conflicts among her employees,  
  she tends to be more biased towards her female employees.  
  
  In the context of the above case answer the following:  
  i) Identify and explain the three principles of management that are being applied by  
  Radhika in this case.  
  ii) Identify and explain the principle of management which is being violated by Radhika.  
  
  3C)   Explain briefly the "Planning Process" with the help of a common example running  
  through the 8 steps.                                                                            (4)  
  
  4A)   The core committee of 'Revels' as well as 'Techtatva' prepare several budgets and submit  
  to the university through proper channels. Briefly discuss the different types of budgets (3)  
  relevant in the above case, with proper examples.  
  
  4B)   List the sources and methods of recruitment.  
  (2)  
  
  4C)   Mr. Raman came with a good proposal and discussed it with his six male friends. Under  
  the changing social, economic and political environments, these seven entrepreneurs  
  would like to start a firm to manufacture copper wire in an innovative method. All the  
  seven entrepreneurs have an engineering background in Mechanical and Manufacturing  
  and are financially sound. They are having adequate knowledge in designing and  
  manufacturing aspects. They are planning to raise the required capital from 3 different  
  sources: (i) promoter's capital (ii) loan from banks (iii) general public in the form of  
  shares and debentures, and, wishing to register their firm as a public limited company.  
  (5)  
  Questions to be answered:  
  
  i) Entrepreneurs can be classified on different criteria. List any four criteria these seven  
  entrepreneurs can be classified as observed in the case.  
  ii) With the help of a block diagram, explain briefly the steps involved in creating and  
  starting the business venture.  
  iii) Differentiate an Intrapreneur from an Entrepreneur  
  
  5A)   Shivamaya Manufacturing is a leading producer of electronic components in Asia. It              (4)  
  aims to showcase the effectiveness of various control mechanisms in managing and  
  improving its operations. The company uses automated sensors and monitoring devices  
  throughout the production line to track the speed of assembly, detect potential defects,  
  and measure the utilization of machinery. If deviations from the standard operating

  delays or defects. After shipping products to customers, company actively engages with  
  its users through customer surveys, online reviews, and direct communication channels.  
  As a protocol, before launching any new line of microprocessors, company conducts

  in anticipation of potential supply chain challenges.  
  
  Questions to be answered:  
  
  As a control enthusiast,  
  i) cite lines from the case, to identify the control systems used by Shivamaya  
  Manufacturing and explain briefly  
  ii) Add your one recommendation to each of the control systems which will be of value  
  addition for Shivamaya Manufacturing  
  
  5B)             In an organization, one of the departmental managers is inflexible and once he makes a  
  decision, he does not like to be contradicted. As a result, employees always feel they are  
  under stress and they take the least initiative and fear to express their opinions and  
  problems before the manager.                                                               (2)  
  List the four systems of management given by Likert. Which leadership style is being  
  followed by the manager in the above case?  
  
  5C)             Critically analyze Kohlberg's and Gilligan's theories of moral development.  
  (4)
